title: Discovery of a novel quinoxaline derivative modulator via a dual P53/TLR2 targeting strategy for the alleviation of radiation damage.
authors: He, Zhaolun; Cui, Yaowen; Chen, Tingting; Xu, Jing; Yang, Xin; Song, Li; Wang, Lin; Peng, Tao; Liu, Shuchen; Zhang, Shouguo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型喹喔啉衍生物Z9通过P53/TLR2双靶点缓解辐射损伤，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物设计而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: With the development of nuclear technology, the risk of people being exposed to nuclear radiation is increasing. So the development of efficient and safe radiation protection agents for nuclear emergencies is urgent. In this study, a series of novel quinoxaline molecules were designed and synthesized with Ex-RAD and TLR2 agonist as the lead, showing anti-radiation effects and compound Z9 was the best one of them. Our work indicated that Z9 emerged as a potent dual modulator targeting both TLR2 and P53 pathway, remarkably preventing the radiation-induced death in mice with the survival rate of 100 %. In the same time, Z9 had significant radioprotection of the haematopoietic system and intestinal villi in mice. In addition, Z9 significantly reduced radiation-induced apoptosis, DNA damage, P53 and Bax expression of AHH-1, while Z9 up-regulated the expressions of TLR2 downstream proteins MyD88 and P65 of HUVECs. Notably, Z9 showed excellent stability and affinity for the TLR2 protein conjugate in molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations. These findings suggested that Z9 was worth further research being a potential candidate for anti-radiation drugs, as the dual modulator of P53/TLR2.
abstract_zh: 随着核技术的发展，人们暴露于核辐射的风险日益增加。因此，开发用于核应急的高效且安全的辐射防护剂迫在眉睫。本研究以Ex-RAD和TLR2激动剂为先导化合物，设计并合成了一系列新型喹喔啉分子，显示出抗辐射效果，其中化合物Z9表现最佳。我们的研究表明，Z9作为一种靶向TLR2和P53通路的强效双重调节剂，显著防止了辐射诱导的小鼠死亡，存活率达到100%。同时，Z9对小鼠的造血系统和肠绒毛具有显著的辐射保护作用。此外，Z9显著减少了辐射诱导的AHH-1细胞凋亡、DNA损伤及P53和Bax表达，而Z9上调了HUVECs中TLR2下游蛋白MyD88和P65的表达。值得注意的是，在分子对接和分子动力学模拟中，Z9对TLR2蛋白偶联物表现出优异的稳定性和亲和力。这些发现表明，Z9作为P53/TLR2双重调节剂，值得进一步研究，有望成为抗辐射药物的潜在候选物。
